LanguageData.LP_MarilithKin.label: marilith
LanguageData.LP_MarilithKin.description: The marilith bloodline: six arms swinging blades at once, a serpent tail gliding through mud and shallows and constricting enemies; the body can withstand the fire and cold of the Abyss, but fears the cold. The bloodline is passed on to children.
LanguageData.LP_MarilithKin.descriptionShort: Inheritable serpent-bodied race. Melee weapons in the pack serve as off-hands for flurries, blade storm, constrict; fast in mud and shallows, resistant to fire, cold and poison, fears cold.
